components.description: Backstage Unity game, derived from YARG
instructions: Preserve Unity .meta files, serialized assets, and the existing Git LFS rules.
Public product branding is Backstage. Preserve YARG attribution, license notices, internal namespaces, serialized GUIDs, and dependency identities.
Build with the pinned Unity editor and initialized pinned YARG.Core submodule. A source-only check is not game-build or gameplay evidence.
Record the Unity editor version and any platform-specific build checks in the feature handoff.

components.description: MacRiff controller setup and bridge reference project
instructions: The source files are under build/; do not ignore or remove that whole directory.
Keep generated .app bundles, binaries, settings backups, and live device/session state local.
Do not change system permissions, controller settings, or launch privileged bridges as part of a documentation or planning task.
Distinguish source-level checks from hardware verification and state which devices were actually exercised.
Backstage is a native game target. Keep unsupported bridge routes disabled until verified against Backstage; never inject Clone Hero-specific adapters into it.

components.description: Python song conversion and chart generation reference project
instructions: Keep conversion output/, caches, downloaded media, and local dependencies out of Git.
Preserve the existing example charts when importing reference files; treat generated results separately from fixtures.
Record audio/model/network dependencies and use focused checks for chart or pipeline changes.
Do not claim that a chart is playable based only on successful file generation.
Publish validated completed songs atomically to the shared Backstage Songs folder; never expose partial conversions as installed songs.
